tests.Name: pal_boot
tests.Expected: BASIC 64 banner and READY prompt

tests.Name: video_model_constants
tests.Expected: PAL6569 and NTSC6567R8 use independent documented timing constants

tests.Name: video_exact_frame_period
tests.Expected: Every raster register value, full line length and exact frame wrap follow the selected model

tests.Name: video_high_raster_irq
tests.Expected: Raster260 triggers exactly at its first cycle and write-one acknowledges it

tests.Name: video_sprite_bus_slots
tests.Expected: All eight pointer/data DMA slots, including NTSC cycles64/65, occur without PAL wrapping

tests.Name: video_badline_bus_slots
tests.Expected: Both standards retain forty matrix/character fetches and the three-cycle BA lead

tests.Name: video_sid_sample_clock
tests.Expected: One second of the selected CPU/SID clock produces44100 mono samples, within one output buffer

tests.Name: video_frontend_selection
tests.Expected: Frontend video switches preserve mode arguments and reject conflicting selections

tests.Name: video_native_frame_pacing
tests.Expected: The complete running machine produces exactly three frames in three model frame periods

tests.Name: video_rom_autodetection
tests.Expected: The ROM detects the actual raster standard and publishes PAL1/NTSC0 at$02A6

tests.Name: video_rom_jiffy_rate
tests.Expected: The native CIA/ROM clock advances60 jiffies per emulated second under either video standard

tests.Name: video_last_text_row_visible
tests.Expected: The actual VIC renders the last text row inside the PAL/NTSC framebuffer with its color RAM

tests.Name: video_savestate_same_model
tests.Expected: A same-model savestate restores RAM and the machine's raster/peripheral state

tests.Name: video_savestate_model_guard
tests.Expected: A mismatched video-standard snapshot is rejected before mutating RAM

tests.Name: video_sprite_visible_control
tests.Expected: Overlapping solid sprites3/4 at X100/Y60 set both collision bits and render one complete24x21 red sprite
tests.Output: PAL: D01E=18, active row=True, border=False, red pixels=504

tests.Name: video_sprite_precrop_collision
tests.Expected: Sprites3/4 at Y0 collide behind the closed border; viewport cropping/wrapping cannot suppress D01E

tests.Name: string_slices
tests.Expected: AB:DE:BCD

tests.Name: rem_program
tests.Expected: REM OK

tests.Name: quoted_data_colon
tests.Expected: A:B:PRINT

tests.Name: gosub_return
tests.Expected: SUB then DONE

tests.Name: division_by_zero
tests.Expected: DIVISION BY ZERO error

tests.Name: sys_returns
tests.Expected: SYS OK

tests.Name: physical_cia_keyboard
tests.Expected: CIA1 matrix key presses type PRINT 1+1 and produce 2 with host input injection disabled

tests.Name: physical_run_stop
tests.Expected: Actual Tab matrix key stops an infinite program with BREAK and preserves its counter/program

tests.Name: physical_stop_cont

tests.Name: physical_restore_alone
tests.Expected: PageUp alone triggers exactly one NMI while held and returns without clearing program or variables

tests.Name: physical_stop_restore
tests.Expected: Tab+PageUp performs warm recovery from a running loop while preserving program and variables

tests.Name: physical_restore_repress
